say:1:1820904001:1.text: You look at the uninfected hornleaf bear. The bear looks back.
say:1:1820904001:1.source_cn: 你看着没有被赤烛蕊寄生的叶角熊，叶角熊也看着你。
say:1:1820904001:1.male: You look at the uninfected hornleaf bear. The bear looks back.
say:1:1820904001:1.female: You look at the uninfected hornleaf bear. The bear looks back.

say:2:1820904002:1.text: You circle it once and <style="highlight">confirm that it bears no trace of infection</style>... How strange.
say:2:1820904002:1.source_cn: 然后你绕着它走了一圈，<style=highlight...
say:2:1820904002:1.male: You circle it once and <style="highlight">confirm that it bears no trace of infection</style>... How strange.
say:2:1820904002:1.female: You circle it once and <style="highlight">confirm that it bears no trace of infection</style>... How strange.

say:3:1820904003:1.text: Lost in thought, you fail to notice the bear's growing irritation—until a deep warning growl rumbles from its throat.
say:3:1820904003:1.source_cn: 你沉浸在思考之中，完全没有注意到刚才的行为惹恼了叶角熊...
say:3:1820904003:1.male: Lost in thought, you fail to notice the bear's growing irritation—until a deep warning growl rumbles from its throat.
say:3:1820904003:1.female: Lost in thought, you fail to notice the bear's growing irritation—until a deep warning growl rumbles from its throat.

say:5:1820904005:1.text: Point taken. Best to back off.
say:5:1820904005:1.source_cn: 还是离远些吧，赶在它发怒之前。
say:5:1820904005:1.male: Point taken. Best to back off.
say:5:1820904005:1.female: Point taken. Best to back off.
